_README: Where cluster-xrd.yaml comes from. It is a byte-identical copy of the eks-fleet Cluster XRD at `upstream.ref` — never hand-edit it. `sha256` is verified by xrd_contract_test.go before the schema is parsed, and `task xrd:check` re-verifies the digest and matches the bytes against upstream at that same ref. `task xrd:sync -- <sha>` moves the pin and rewrites the digest together. See README.md in this directory.
